header.act: ACT I — THE EASTERN FRONT BREAKS
player.speaker: Front Commissar
line.fekete-cold-open.speaker: András Fekete
line.fekete-cold-open.text: Don't use the station clock; it's stopped at six. The Zilah trains are arriving without schedules, with wounded men and guns whose teams we've lost. I need the sidings cleared. You can already hear Romanian artillery beyond them.
line.kun-field-wire.speaker: Béla Kun
line.kun-field-wire.role: People's Commissar for Foreign Affairs — Field Telephone
line.kun-field-wire.text: Böhm, I need that railway kept open. Károlyi resigned over the new demarcation line; we inherited his empty depots, and now the Romanians are forcing us west. Paris is waiting to see whether this government can keep an army.
line.bohm-opening.speaker: Vilmos Böhm
line.bohm-opening.text: Look at the battalions on that line. Some have no artillery, and the villages are receiving orders from three headquarters. The Romanians crossed at dawn. Give me time to get the army onto the trains; I cannot stop them here.
line.bohm-political-objection.speaker: Vilmos Böhm
line.bohm-political-objection.role: Social Democrat and People's Commissar for Military Affairs
line.bohm-political-objection.text: The officers loading those trains talk about defending Hungary. So do most of the soldiers. If you ask them to fight only for world revolution, Kun, you'll lose men we need. They have to believe we're defending their country too.
line.kun-political.speaker: Béla Kun
line.kun-political.text: And what happens when those officers are offered the old flag without the councils? We need them, Böhm, but they don't get to decide what the Republic is for. Commissar, settle the rear guard: hold Nagykároly station, or keep moving along the roads?
Fortify the station and approaches. Every additional hour lets more men, guns, and rolling stock escape west.
Gain an entrenched infantry detachment and near-full core resupply, but forgo the prestige and reconnaissance experience of the mobile rear guard.
line.kun-political.choice.mobile-guard.t: Keep the rear guard mobile. Delay each enemy column, then withdraw before it closes the road behind us.
line.kun-political.choice.mobile-guard.h: Gain a prestige award and experience for every core reconnaissance unit, but forgo the infantry detachment and near-full resupply.
line.fekete-railway.speaker: András Fekete
line.fekete-railway.text: I'll keep the locomotives under steam. Wounded men and guns go west first. Keep the cavalry off the sidings until the last train clears; after that I'll destroy the timetables we leave behind.
line.bohm-mobile.speaker: Vilmos Böhm
line.bohm-mobile.text: Give every commander a withdrawal road and an hour. I don't want a battalion staying in a village because it can't find the next headquarters. Once the rails are cut, we won't be able to get its guns out.
line.bohm-final.speaker: Vilmos Böhm
line.bohm-final.text: Headquarters goes to the western road. Keep infantry between the cavalry and the trains. Fekete, telephone me while you still have a line; I need to know what has got through.
